scripts.dev: npm run clean && npm run encrypt && hugo server --disableFastRender
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run encrypt && hugo --minify && npm run search
scripts.update:theme: git submodule update --remote themes/pure && cp themes/pure/starter/scripts/encrypt-posts.mjs scripts/encrypt-posts.mjs && git add themes/pure scripts/encrypt-posts.mjs && (git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m 'chore: update theme') && npm run encrypt
